description: Splits a PDF into one new file per comma-separated range, named -part1, -part2 and so on. "1-2, 3-end" gives two files, and one call writes at most 1,000 (or one per page for longer PDFs). Never replaces an existing file; the input is left unchanged.

output_folder.description: Optional absolute path of an existing folder for the files. By default they go next to the input.

path.description: Absolute path to a PDF file, or one starting with ~/.

ranges.description: Ranges such as "1-2, 3, 4-end": one output file per comma-separated part

name: split_pdf

output_paths.description: The new PDFs, one per range

title: Split a PDF
